title: Market Rotation Agent
author: One-Cellist-8159
selftext:
We are entering into the times where S&P is not going to be an attractive investment for next 10 years and it should jumps back and forth between +2% to -2% annual returns for next 10 years or so. However economy will continue to grow. Money will flow from one asset class to another and so on. I am working on developing trading tools to find out opportunities outside S&P and beat it.

  
I have created a market intelligence suite of agents. One of them is a rotation agent which gives an early signal of increasing rotation pressure. This has helped me in choosing the right stocks at right time along with other agents in Edge Cipher market intelligence module. Here is the snapshot of from today's session.

comments.author: TrustedEssentials
comments.body: How far ahead are these signals meant to work, and have you compared them with simply ranking sectors by their recent performance?

replies.author: One-Cellist-8159
replies.body: This signals normally works for 2 weeks to even 10 weeks or more out. But rotation pressure alone is not a signal but i have other agents which looks at the pressure from other angles like RSI. Price performance is just a tip of an iceberg, This agent above initially had a performance measurement only but added volume details to it for better accuracy.

replies.author: TrustedEssentials
replies.body: When the rotation reading and RSI disagree, do you wait for them to line up, or does one carry more weight?

replies.author: One-Cellist-8159
replies.body:
I use RSI to answer How is leadership evolving, while this rotation pressure map tells me which groups look relatively stronger or weaker recently, with volume considered?”

they can disagree - and both be useful

Suppose Technology has been a strong leader for three months but has a weak week with elevated volume:

RSI agent: It could remain in Leading, with its trail starting to turn toward Weakening.

Rotation Agent: It could already show negative weekly pressure.

That means recent weakness within a longer-term leadership trend - not necessarily a confirmed reversal.

The reverse can happen too: a long-term laggard can show strong daily pressure without having established a durable recovery.

replies.author: TrustedEssentials
replies.body: When you say RSI, do you mean the usual 0–100 indicator, or relative-strength/rotation rankings? Could you walk through one recent example of what made you enter, where you would exit if it went wrong, and what made you take profits?

replies.author: One-Cellist-8159
replies.body: hmmm, i need to create video tutorial for this flow. It is not just RSI but RSI based agent to determine rotation.

comments.author: investigatormaker
comments.body:
Readers here will test "gives an early signal of increasing rotation pressure", and one session's snapshot can't show early. Timestamp each signal as it fires, then check 20 sessions later how often money really moved, false alarms included. Benchmark against an equal-weight sector mix too: if the S&P stays flat for a decade, beating it proves little. A live record takes months to mean anything, but threads asking how to spot rotation early are where it would earn attention.
